description: Source code for WebTransportStreamAdapter class implementing stream operations and error handling in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: WebTransportStreamAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for WebTransport stream operations, including read, write, and error handling.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer or string, updating internal state.

methods.name: Writev
methods.description: Writes multiple data buffers to the stream, handling partial writes and errors.

methods.name: CheckBeforeStreamWrite
methods.description: Checks if the stream is ready for writing.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Returns whether the stream is writable.

methods.name: AbruptlyTerminate
methods.description: Terminates the stream abruptly with an error.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: OnDataAvailable
methods.description: Handles notification that data is available to read.

methods.name: OnCanWriteNewData
methods.description: Handles notification that the stream can accept new data.

methods.name: ResetWithUserCode
methods.description: Resets the stream with a specific error code.

methods.name: SendStopSending
methods.description: Sends a stop-sending signal with an error code.
